# Minastik

> Minastik is an AI/LLM and digital-transformation company. This file points AI assistants to
> Minastik's openly available learning material.

## Learn
- [Recommender Systems from Zero](https://minastik.com/recsys/): a free, hand-checkable, from-zero
  handbook on recommender systems (linear algebra to graph- and LLM-based collaborative filtering).
  Full content map: https://minastik.com/recsys/llms.txt
- (add learning notes, books and articles here as they ship)
